subject: Insurance
title: The Black Box Problem
description: A quick, practical guide to The Black Box Problem.

hook.text: When AI denies your insurance claim, nobody can explain exactly why.

buildup.text: Deep learning models process millions of variables through hidden layers. The output is a decision, not an explanation.

discovery.text: EU regulations now require a 'right to explanation' for automated decisions.

twist.text: Explainable AI (XAI) is a growing field, but making complex models interpretable often reduces their accuracy.

climax.text: Insurance faces a choice: opaque models that perform best, or transparent models that people can challenge in court.

punchline.text: The AI says no, but can't say why. Transparency or accuracy—pick one.

quiz.question: What is the 'black box problem' in AI insurance?
options: Insurers use black boxes in cars
AI decisions can't be explained even by their creators
